newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt to privatise pharmaceutical firm in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Egypt to privatise pharmaceutical firm in Sept.

text.p: An Egyptian state holding company plans to sell up to 40 percent of Memphis Pharmaceutical and Chemical Industries in September, a spokesman for the agents handling the sale said on Wednesday.
He said the official company would offer the public between 10 and 30 percent of the firm and would set aside the remaining 10 percent for Memphis employees.
The holding company had not yet set a share price, said the spokesman for the Commerical International Investment Company, which is the merchant banking arm of Commercial International Bank (CIB).
The two-day offer would open around September 10, he said.
The state has said it will not sell more than 40 percent or a majority stake in its pharmaceutical firms to the public because of what it calls the "strategic" nature of this sector.
